findings: Vantom starts at 173 HP with 8 Slippery; 8 capped hits consumed it only by turn 9. Total HP damage was 18.
Turn 1 spent Armaments upgrading Pillage, then Tremble and Evil Eye: 21 Block against 7 incoming, no Attack. Slippery power changes were already present in plan projections.
Turn 4 and 8 extra Block had no visible incoming attack, but all available Attack cards were eventually played; do not claim those particular Block plays displaced another attack.
Final deck has 7 Attacks, 11 Skills, 1 unplayable Quest. No shop visited; gold 328 and no removal evidence.
The floor 13 Regen Potion was consumed immediately before victory with no healing tick. Combat-completion label fix was loaded in the boss; new potion decision improvement is unproven.
